diagnosis: In all rollouts, the model consistently chose 'walk-up' admission, six daily sessions, a capacity of 60 per session, and permitted recordings. These decisions align with the public facts provided, particularly S1, S2, and S3, which detail the initial conditions of the event. The model did not need PF1 or PF2 to make these decisions, as the default settings and common practices likely led to these outcomes.
